ibperf._comment_rocm_dir: ROCm installation path. Set to auto-detect from /opt/rocm or /opt/rocm/core-* if left as changeme
ibperf._comment_pairing_mode: Server/client node pairing: sequential (cluster file order), inter_vpod (each pair spans two vPODs - scale-out), intra_vpod (pairs within one vPOD)
ibperf._comment_vpod_source: vPOD discovery for inter_vpod/intra_vpod: afm (afmctl show device --json, single scale-up domain only) or cluster_file (node_dict[<node>].vpod_id)
